$comment: Machine-readable rules + allowlist for scripts/check-boundaries.mjs. The rules ARE the future repo seams (AIO-597, Wave 1 of the multi-repo split) — see ../CLAUDE.md and RESOLVER.md for the planned topology. `grandfathered` entries are ratchet-only-down: every entry is a REAL, MEASURED coupling in the current tree, not a projection. Adding a new grandfather entry always needs a reason; removing one (by fixing the coupling) never needs permission.

rules.description: scripts/<cmd>/* is importable only via its own top-level barrel scripts/<cmd>.mjs, or from another file inside the same scripts/<cmd>/ directory (same-dir siblings). Any other scripts/** file reaching directly into a different cmd's subdirectory bypasses the barrel and is a seam violation — the future @aios-alpha/toolkit-common split will physically separate these directories from whatever doesn't go through the barrel.

hooks/** may import a top-level scripts/*.mjs barrel, but must never reach directly into a scripts/<cmd>/ subdirectory. Hooks ship into every scaffolded workspace (scaffold/.claude via `aios update`) and must depend only on stable public entry points, not another cmd's internals.

src/** (the future @aios-alpha/operator-loop package) must never import scripts/** (aios-workspace core / the future @aios-alpha/toolkit-common). The operator loop is a client of the toolkit, never the reverse — Engineering Constitution direction of dependency.
Nothing outside test/** may import test/**. Tests are a leaf: fixtures and helpers stay test-only, never a dependency of production code.

Core files must not import from the devtools path set — scripts/ship.mjs, scripts/ship/**, scripts/build.mjs, scripts/roadmap-run.mjs, scripts/spec-eval.mjs, scripts/spec-publish.mjs, scripts/consolidate-findings.mjs — which moves to the aiosbrain/aios-devtools repo (AIO-594). Devtools-internal imports are fine, and devtools files may import core: the dependency direction of the cut is devtools → core, never the reverse. Core-shared surfaces extracted for this rule: scripts/verify-cmd.mjs (D1), scripts/severity.mjs (D2), scripts/spec-checks.mjs (D3), scripts/scan-file.mjs (D5). Like R1-R4, R6 scans production sources only: test files are exempt as import sources — which tests leave with the cut is decided by the devtools extraction paths manifest, not by this gate.
